shared_elements: band of repeated geometric marks (feather rows in A, zigzag/triangle band in B)
justification: Both surfaces show relief creatures in profile and include bird/feather imagery plus a strip of repeated angular marks, but these are generic correspondences. A is a single dense composite anthropomorphic figure in frontal pose with headdress, pectoral plaque and outspread feathered wings filling the whole field, while B is organised in stacked registers of separate, sparse, isolated animals (a row of heads, a quadruped, a bird), with no shared specific motif or relationship.
